title: Past continuous: review
instructionEs: Preguntas mezcladas de toda la unidad.

items.explanationEs: Pregunta en pasado continuo con you: Were you…? Did no va con -ing.

items.prompt: I ___ my keys while I was running.
items.explanationEs: Perder las llaves es algo corto que pasa de repente: pasado simple, lost.

items.statement: It was raining when we left the cinema.
items.explanationEs: La lluvia es el fondo (was raining); salir, lo que pasó (left).

items.statement: While I was cooking, my brother was set the table.
items.explanationEs: Después de was, el verbo con -ing: was setting the table.

answers: Were they playing in the park?

items.text: When you phoned, I ___ (to take) a shower.
items.explanationEs: Lo que estaba haciendo cuando sonó el teléfono: was taking.

items.source: The children were making a lot of noise.
answers: The children weren't making a lot of noise.
items.explanationEs: Negativa con un plural: weren't + verbo con -ing.

items.sentence: I was walk to school when it started to rain.
items.explanationEs: Después de was, el verbo con -ing: was walking.
